Method of Attack: Allows authenticated attackers to reset WordPress sites and delete almost all database content and uploaded media by exploiting failure to perform nonce checks and leaking AJAX nonce to low-privileged users

Abuse of hdi_install_demo AJAX function with reset parameter set to true triggers database_reset function truncating database tables except wp_options, wp_users, wp_usermeta and clear_uploads function deleting all files in wp-content/uploads
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Hashthemes Demo Importer plugin
Attack Vector: Authenticated users including low-privileged subscriber-level users exploiting leaked AJAX nonce on admin dashboard
Indicators of Compromise: Exploitation of hdi_install_demo AJAX function with reset=true
Database tables truncated except wp_options, wp_users, wp_usermeta
Deletion of all files in wp-content/uploads
Plugin removal from WordPress repository on September 20, 2021
